## OKR (OK)

Objective + contained Key Results, each carrying start/target/current so progress is always derived — a KR cannot claim more than its metric shows. Overall progress is the mean of KR progress. The 0.7-is-success ambition norm is a reading convention, not an enforced threshold.

### Non-goals

No check-in cadence or history (a check-in would be its own dated record). No cascading/alignment tree between OKRs in v1.
